title.zh: 补全首日验收证据明细

purpose.en: Correct the August 21 Project record so its final runtime report contains each language's measured evidence and both blockers without claiming a full pass.
purpose.zh: 修正 8 月 21 日 Project 记录，让最终运行时报告逐语显示实测证据与两项受阻内容，且不声称全量通过。

en: Publish the four per-language evidence rows directly through the deployment-generated Project report.
Preserve the sentence-bank, route-preflight, signed-in Chrome, score-log, and clean-console evidence.
Keep real microphone scoring and administrator-level ledger verification explicitly blocked.
zh: 通过部署生成的 Project 报告直接发布四种语言的逐语证据。
保留句子题库、路由预检、真实登录 Chrome、分数日志与无错误控制台证据。
继续将真实麦克风评分与管理员级账本复核明确标记为受阻。
8 月 21 日正式站验收证据

en: Move the per-language measurements into the deployment manifest consumed by the authoritative runtime Project record.
Use only the anonymized learner key and non-secret production evidence.
Keep the report explicitly blocked where real speech input or administrator-only read access was unavailable.
zh: 把逐语实测数据写入权威运行时 Project 记录直接读取的部署清单。
只使用匿名学习者键与非敏感正式站证据。
真实语音输入或管理员只读权限不可用时，报告明确保持受阻。

en: Sentence and QA contracts pass for 36 course banks, 120 sentences per bank, and ten unique daily Listening and Writing items.
The August 21 route preflight passed all 16 anonymous production route checks.

English: 1 minute planned and 7 learning-log minutes measured; speaking deep focus; five Course skills, SmartCard, and Everyday Speaking playback/navigation completed; persisted server quiz 100/100; real microphone scoring blocked.

Japanese: 5 minutes planned and 20 learning-log minutes measured; writing deep focus with two extra checked questions; Course, SmartCard, and Everyday Speaking playback/navigation completed; persisted server quiz 100/100; real microphone scoring blocked.

Spanish: 2 minutes planned and 20 learning-log minutes measured; vocabulary deep focus; Course, extra vocabulary feedback, SmartCard, and Everyday Speaking playback/navigation completed; persisted server quiz 100/100; real microphone scoring blocked.

Italian: 5 minutes planned and 21 learning-log minutes measured; vocabulary deep focus; Course, extra vocabulary feedback, SmartCard, and Everyday Speaking playback/navigation completed; persisted server quiz 100/100; real microphone scoring blocked.
Writing and Listening displayed checked correct-or-incorrect feedback and advanced their visible counters in every language; no browser console errors or warnings were observed.

No payment, referral, certificate, challenge, leaderboard, or completed SmartCard claim flow was entered. Database-level ledger verification remains blocked because the run used exactly the designated learner and no administrator identity.
zh: 句子与测试合同通过：36 个课程题库、每库 120 句，Listening 与 Writing 每日各 10 道唯一题。
8 月 21 日匿名正式站 route preflight 的 16 项检查全部通过。
英语：计划 1 分钟、学习日志计量 7 分钟；深度技能为口语；课程五技能、SmartCard 与生活口语播放/导航完成；持久化服务器测验 100/100；真实麦克风评分受阻。
日语：计划 5 分钟、学习日志计量 20 分钟；深度技能为写作并额外检查两题；课程、SmartCard 与生活口语播放/导航完成；持久化服务器测验 100/100；真实麦克风评分受阻。
西班牙语：计划 2 分钟、学习日志计量 20 分钟；深度技能为词汇；课程、额外词汇反馈、SmartCard 与生活口语播放/导航完成；持久化服务器测验 100/100；真实麦克风评分受阻。
意大利语：计划 5 分钟、学习日志计量 21 分钟；深度技能为词汇；课程、额外词汇反馈、SmartCard 与生活口语播放/导航完成；持久化服务器测验 100/100；真实麦克风评分受阻。
四语写作与听力均显示已检查的正确或错误反馈，并推进可见题号；浏览器控制台未发现错误或警告。
未进入支付、推荐、证书、挑战、排行榜或完成整轮 SmartCard 领取流程。因本轮只使用指定学习者且未使用管理员身份，数据库级账本复核保持受阻。

en: Real microphone scoring and administrator-only ledger verification remain blocked and require a later authorized retry.
zh: 真实麦克风评分与管理员专属账本复核仍受阻，需要后续授权重试。

en: This release publishes SmartLingo-specific QA evidence only and changes no learner data, scoring logic, course content, identity, commerce, or classroom boundary.
zh: 本次只发布 SmartLingo 专属验收证据，不改变学习数据、评分逻辑、课程内容、身份、商业或课程教室边界。
